title: The Republic
description: A data-driven civic strategy game in which players navigate institutions, public pressure, limited resources, and uncertain outcomes across multiple social scenarios.
details: I built a Rust server with Axum and Tokio, a responsive Phaser 3 web client, persistent campaigns, and validated JSON/YAML scenario packs so new environments can be added without changing the engine.

title: Nazar India
description: An Indian news aggregator designed to keep original sources, evidence status, disagreements, and editorial confidence visible to the reader.
details: The dependency-free publishing pipeline collects public RSS feeds, uses structured AI-assisted editorial distillation, validates every output, and republishes a searchable static archive through scheduled automation.

title: Chess Duel
description: A private-room chess application for two players, with instant guest play and optional verified accounts for persistent cross-device game history.
details: It combines responsive move interaction with server-authoritative rule validation, transaction-safe real-time synchronization, complete draw conditions, reconnect handling, and durable Appwrite records.

title: WorkAtlas
description: A multi-user workspace for organizing research, software projects, publications, experiments, tasks, and long-term ideas in one structured system.
details: I designed its configuration-driven public pages and database-backed application, including authentication, owner-scoped data, task and Kanban workflows, portable exports, documentation, and production deployment.
